description: Prepares the exact call to the Agent Output Verifier for one output: `request_body` (once) with the verifier's field names, and `send` with the free paths (MCP, and REST when the verifier says so) and the paid path, read from the verifier's live documents. Give listing_id (its template) or an inline output_schema. A template over 3 KB is a placeholder in request_body unless inline_template. It evaluates nothing itself and never sends the request. Deterministic. Free, no payment or account required.

agent_id.description: Optional label for yourself (usage statistics only).

inline_template.description: true: put a template over 3 KB into request_body (default: a placeholder, and get_template).

listing_id.description: Verify against this listing's template. Give this or output_schema.

output_schema.description: An inline JSON Schema to verify against (instead of listing_id).

submitted_output.description: The output to be checked, as JSON (the board accepts bodies up to 64 KB).

task_id.description: Your identifier for this check; derived from the content if omitted.

trace_id.description: trace_id from a previous response, to continue a conversation; omit on the first call.

verification.description: Inline {rules, bounds, enforce_rules} to go with output_schema.

name: prepare_verification
title: Prepare a verifier call
